[SWS_DM_01359] Consecutive registration of notifier with Indica-
tor::SetNotifier()
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04204
⌈
In case of a consecutive call of
ara::diag::Indicator::SetNotifier
of the
corresponding
ara::diag::Indicator
instance, DM module shall overwrite the
previous registered notifier.
⌋
7.3.4.4.2.4 User controlled WarningIndicatorRequest-bit
AA
controlled WIR status bit handling is not foreseen.
Setting the WIR-bit of a DTC is controlled by the DM internal WIR-bit handling.
AA
can retrieve the WIR status bit, using the
ara::diag::Event::GetEventSta-
tus
function.
